articles.title: COP31 deal draft foreshadows difficult route to consensus

articles.title: Russia says intercepted over 1,300 Ukrainian drones in a major attack
articles.description: Russia intercepted 1,336 drones launched by Ukraine, Russia’s Defense Ministry said Monday, in what was the most claimed downings since Moscow’s all-out invasion of its neighbor nearly five years ago. Russia, meanwhile, has battered Ukrainian civilian areas with relentless strikes that seek to choke the economy and break public morale, in attacks President Volodymyr Zelensky said were made possible ⁠partly due to restrictions on Ukraine's use of SpaceX's Starshield service.

articles.title: Ukraine strikes Crimea bridge as Zelensky says Starshield caps helping Russian attacks
articles.description: Ukraine has struck the bridge linking Russia and ⁠Crimea across the Kerch strait, limiting the flow of traffic, the peninsula's Russian-backed governor Sergei Aksyonov ⁠said on Monday. It comes after Russia struck energy and railway infrastructure across Ukraine over the weekend, in attacks President Volodymyr Zelensky said were made possible ⁠partly due to restrictions on Ukraine's use of SpaceX's Starshield service.

articles.title: Xi, Trump and Putin to discuss 'world peace' at Shenzhen summit, China says
articles.description: The Chinese foreign ministry on Monday said that President Xi Jinping and his US and Russian counterparts Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin would discuss "safeguarding world peace and promoting strategic stability" when they hold their first trilateral summit in Shenzhen this week. The meeting is expected to happen on Thursday on the sidelines of a summit of Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) leaders.

articles.title: Eisenkot says Netanyahu ‘cannot remain’ after alleged election interference by aide

articles.title: Iran blocks UN nuclear site visits until war ends
articles.description: Iran's foreign ministry on Monday said that it would block the International Atomic Energy Agency's access to its damaged nuclear facilities until stated conditions for permanently ending the war have been met by the US. articles.title: Francophonie summit avoids 'major disaster' after clash over leadership
